end.text: Barn owls are found all over the world, including in the UK. They like to nest in abandoned barns and buildings or in dense trees.

feedback.end: Barn owls like to hunt at night. They have incredible night vision and extraordinary hearing. Along with their amazing senses, they have sharp claws to catch their prey.

end.text: Barn owls can be recognised by their dark eyes and pale feathers. They can also be recognised by their call. Rather than a normal 'twit-twoo' sound, they make a harsh screeching noise.

instruction.text: There are lots of other owls living in the UK too! Match the owls to the correct names.

hint.text:
Tawny owls are the most common owl in the UK. They are smaller than barn owls and have a mixture of brown and grey feathers.

Long-eared owls are similar in size to barn owls, but darker in colour. They also have tufts of feathers that stick out from the top of their heads, which look like long ears.
